question_text: Calculate the modulus of elasticity of a metal-matrix composite under isostrain conditions. Assume an aluminum matrix is reinforced by $60 \mathrm{vol} \% \mathrm{SiC}$ fibers. Give your answer as the value of modulus_of_elasticity.The unit of the answer is MPa.
response:
For an isostrain (longitudinal) loaded metal-matrix composite, the modulus follows the **rule of mixtures**:

$$E_c = V_m E_m + V_f E_f$$

Using standard moduli:
- Aluminum matrix: $E_m = 69\,\text{GPa} = 69000\,\text{MPa}$
- SiC fibers: $E_f = 410\,\text{GPa} = 410000\,\text{MPa}$
- Volume fractions: $V_f = 0.60$, $V_m = 0.40$

$$E_c = 0.40(69000) + 0.60(410000) = 27600 + 246000 = 273600\,\text{MPa}$$

$$\boxed{273600}$$
